title: Without a word, until dawn
goal: Say what someone did without doing something with -mAn, and how long something went on with -ýAnçA.

intro.text: `-mAn` is the negative of `-(Y)p`, **without …ing**: *Hiç zat diýmän gitdi* (he left without saying anything). `-ýAnçA` means **until**, with *-m*, *-ň*, *-k* for I, you, we: *Men gelýänçäm garaş* (wait until I come), *Ol gelýänçä* (until he comes).

vocab.en: to say hello, to greet (each other)
to continue, to go on; to last
dawn, daybreak (daň atýar: day is breaking)
right up (to), all the way (before -ýAnçA or çenli)

exercises.question: How do you say **without saying anything**?

reject.why: *Hoşlaşyp gitdi*: he **did** say goodbye, then left. **Without**: *hoşlaşman*.

exercises.prompt: I went to work without eating.

reject.answer: Men nahar iýmezden öň işe gitdim.
reject.why: *Iýmezden öň* is **before eating**: you ate later. **Without** eating: *iýmän*.

accept: He walked past without saying hello to me.
She walked past without saying hello to me.
[He|She] went (right) past without saying hello to me.
[He|She] walked right past without saying hello to me.

exercises.question: *Ol gelýänçä garaşaýyn.* What does the speaker offer?

exercises.label: *dolanmak* + `-ýAnçA`: until I come back, until you come back…
exercises.explain: The short endings of the past: *-m*, *-ň*, *-k*, *-ňyz*; nothing for **he**, **she** and **they**.

exercises.prompt: We sat in the café until the rain stopped.
exercises.explain: *Ýagyş gutarýança* (until the rain stopped), then *kafede oturdyk*.

exercises.text: Wait for me until I come back.

accept: We [talked|chatted] until [the morning|morning|the sun came up|day broke].

exercises.title: Synagdan öň
exercises.passage:
Duşenbe güni Myradyň synagy bardy. Ýekşenbe güni ol öýe gelenden soň, nahar iýmän okamaga başlady. Ejesi oňa çaý getirdi, ýöne Myrat çaýy içmän, okamagyny dowam etdi. Ol gije sagat ikä çenli okady.

Duşenbe irden Myrat oýananda, sagat sekiz eken! Synag sagat dokuzda başlanjakdy. Ol ýuwunman, hiç zat iýmän, mekdebe ylgady. Synag başlanmazdan öň, ol mekdebe ýetişdi. Synag gutarýança, Myrat hiç zat iýmedi. Synagdan soň, ol ejesine jaň edip, synagyň gowy geçendigini aýtdy.
exercises.translation: Myrat had an exam on Monday. On Sunday, after coming home, he started studying without eating. His mother brought him tea, but Myrat went on studying without drinking it. He studied until two at night. When Myrat woke up on Monday morning, it was eight o'clock! The exam was going to start at nine. He ran to school without washing and without eating anything. He got to school before the exam started. Until the exam was over, Myrat ate nothing. After the exam, he called his mother and told her the exam had gone well.

questions.q: What did Myrat do after he got home?
questions.explain: *Öýe gelenden soň, nahar iýmän okamaga başlady.*

questions.q: Did Myrat get to school in time?
How long did he go without eating that day?
